2023-4289-4460-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4050-4668-8077-8107.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
4050-4668-8077-8107.description:
Cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {W} due to Heliod.
Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with eight or more +1/+1 counters on it
attached to any creature you control except Sekki

1475-1724-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sekki
When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

394-856-3899-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

4871-5220-5686-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5686-7806.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

7647-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control eight or more Squirrels.
7647-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Supportive Parents four times by tapping eight Squirrels, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat from step 1.
7647-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first eight will be untapped and can be used to create more mana if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

104-1379-2685-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1379-2685-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

443-997-1263-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3457-7221-7791.notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.
3457-7221-7791.description:
Activate Lys Alana Dignitary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Lys Alana Dignitary.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Lys Alana Dignitary.
Repeat.

876-3784-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Vhal.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Vhal.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Vhal.
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Vhal.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Vhal.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Vhal from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

618-3536-4456-7494.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to name "Seething Song".
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3490-5445-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2292-3490-5445-7426.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

2308-3641-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-3641-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1395-3459-4289-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1369-6478-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Arbor Adherent.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Arbor Adherent's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Arbor Adherent's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Arbor Adherent's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-4846-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-6633.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2707-5751-6504-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
2707-5751-6504-7010.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

2474-3011-4090.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
2474-3011-4090.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to 1.5 times their life total, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

2935-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power.
2935-4567.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

224-277-1772-3257.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Holding priority, activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

678-4766-5315.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken creature you control.
678-4766-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3118-4846.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Bearer of the Heavens.
3118-4846.description:
Kill Bearer of the Heavens.
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
At the beginning of your end step, Bearer of the Heaves triggers, destroying all permanents.
When Worldgorger Dragon dies, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield under their owner's control.

549-969-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
549-969-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-969-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch // Temple of Cyclical Time

2511-5550-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2511-5550-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

643-1558-3263-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other creatures.
643-1558-3263-4302.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Angels due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers five times.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability from step 1, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

586-618-5200.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
586-618-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix.
The Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

957-3742-4125.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
957-3742-4125.description:
Cast Time Stretch, taking an extra two turns after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser that is tapped and attacking.
Shipwreck Dowser enters, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

738-3370-4050-5004.description:
Sacrifice Cathodion to Phyrexian Altar, adding one mana of any color.
Cathodion and Butcher of Malakir trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Butcher of Malakir's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Cathodion to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
